title: Pumpkin festival – level 2
paragraphs: A famous autumn pumpkin festival opened at a castle near Brussels. Around 50,000 visitors are expected to attend it.

The event celebrates pumpkins and squashes of all shapes and sizes, brought from Belgium, Portugal, and Germany. The biggest pumpkin at the festival weighs an impressive 772 kilograms. Even though the summer was very hot and made farming difficult, the harvest display is still wonderful. Visitors can enjoy many fun activities, such as carving pumpkins for Halloween or watching giant pumpkins used as boats on the water.
Families and autumn fans gather at the castle to celebrate the season, enjoy the festive atmosphere, and see creative pumpkin art.

words.d: something big, important, or of good quality
